sections.heading: Your starter tools
sections.body: Equipping your crafted weapon awards a Pickaxe for Mining, a Hatchet for Woodcutting, and a Skinning Knife for Skinning. All three appear in your inventory.

sections.heading: Choose one tool
sections.body: You can equip one gathering tool at a time. Select any starter tool from your inventory and equip it in the Tool slot. You can swap tools whenever you want to target another resource.

sections.heading: Gather while fighting
sections.body: Combat areas show their available gathering nodes. After victories, your equipped tool automatically attempts to collect from a matching node: Pickaxes gather Ore, Hatchets gather Wood, and Skinning Knives gather Hide.
